# hx_rnl — Agent Instructions

Haxe bindings over the native RNL networking library. Targets: hxcpp and HashLink.

## Critical: Generated files

These files are auto-generated by `tools/gen_raw.py` — never edit by hand:
- `source/rnl/raw/Raw.hx`
- `source/rnl/raw/RawUnavailable.hx`
- `project/hdll/rnl_hdll.c`

To regenerate after `lib/rnl.h` changes:
```
python3 tools/gen_raw.py ../lib/rnl.h
```
Then recompile the hdll if working on HashLink target.

## Build commands

From `example/`:
```
./run.sh cpp    # hxcpp native binary
./run.sh hl     # HashLink bytecode (.hl)
./run.sh hlc    # HashLink compiled to C then gcc
./run.sh all    # all three
```

Or directly with haxe (from `example/`):
```
haxe -cp ../source -main Main --cpp bin/cpp -D HXCPP_M64    # hxcpp
haxe -cp ../source -main Main --hl bin/hl/Main.hl           # hl bytecode
```

## Code style

`hxformat.json`: opening braces on same line as declaration, empty braces on separate line. Haxe code uses tabs for indentation.

## Key architecture notes

- `source/rnl/raw/Raw.hx` — 1:1 FFI bindings (458 functions), platform-conditional via `#if hl` / `#if cpp` / `#else` stubs
- `source/rnl/raw/Types.hx` — platform typedefs for `Ptr` and `CharPtr`
- `source/rnl/internal/RnlBuild.hx` — `@:buildXml` helper for hxcpp linking (import from Main class)
- `source/rnl/Native.hx` — cross-platform helpers for buffer/Int64 manipulation
- `source/rnl/*.hx` — high-level OOP wrappers (Instance, Host, Network, Peer, Channel, Address, etc.)
- `ndll/` — prebuilt native libs: `ndll/Linux64/librnl.so`, `ndll/HL64/rnl.hdll`, `ndll/win64/`, `ndll/android-arm/`, `ndll/android-arm64/`

## hxcpp linking gotcha

Libraries go inside `<target id="haxe">`, NOT `<files id="haxe">`. Include the `-l` prefix:
```xml
<target id="haxe">
    <libpath name="/path/to/dir/containing/librnl.so" />
    <lib name="-lrnl" />
</target>
```

## Runtime deps

- hxcpp: copy `librnl.so` next to binary or set `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`
- HL: place `rnl.hdll` + `librnl.so` next to `.hl` file or in `HL_PATH`

## External dependency

The library header lives at `../lib/rnl.h` and prebuilt binaries at `../lib/bin/`. The `RnlBuild.hx` file hardcodes the path to `../lib` for the include flag — adjust if the repo layout changes.
